title: Groovie language file
description: One file per language. Add a language by adding <code>.json; no Swift changes are required.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag. Must match the file name.

name.description: Language name in that language, e.g. 日本語.

fallback.description: Language used for missing keys. Normally en.

complete.description: True once every en key is translated. make l10n-check treats a complete language strictly.
